headline: South Tyrol's Private Sector Employs More People, but Wages Are Losing Real Value
summary: More people are working in South Tyrol's private sector, but despite nominal wage increases, wages have declined clearly in real terms since 2019.
why: Real wages measure purchasing power after inflation, which shapes consumer spending and regional labour-market conditions. South Tyrol is an autonomous Italian province with a large tourism and services economy.
